Without --frozen, uv re-resolves against the env-var index and the report says that works, which fits the lockfile being the constraint. search_uv_docs and the indexes doc describe UV_INDEX_STRATEGY and UV_DEFAULT_INDEX as resolution-time settings and do not say they override lockfile URLs under --frozen. Searches found no duplicate. Not a defect in another tool, so not external. The reporter's template says bug, but this looks like working-as-intended behaviour that needs a documented workaround (re-lock with the proxy index, or drop --frozen), so question.
